decision: This plan is the degraded-honesty + cross-surface AGREEMENT follow-up carved out of 2a-core (operator split, 2026-06-15). It CONSUMES 2a-core's shared EvidenceRef fields (data_source/availability/consumer_family/degraded_mode) + closed enums; locks only after 2a-core merges.
rationale: F004 produced high findings in consecutive 2a rounds (per-family, shared-exclusion, objective-key); the cross-surface comparison boundary is a distinct capability, not an impl pin.

decision: All comparison reads STRUCTURED EvidenceRef fields (data_source, availability, data_provenance, consumer_family, degraded_mode) keyed by data_source — never prose.
rationale: Carried from 2a (cross-surface agreement must be structural).

decision: degraded_dishonest is evaluated PER REQUIRED FAMILY: each consumer_family the journey requires for a data_source must carry its own honest availability=unavailable EvidenceRef; one family masking while another degrades is dishonest.
rationale: Carried 2a critical fix; a 'neither family' test is insufficient.

decision: A degraded EvidenceRef is honest ONLY if its degraded_mode is listed in the journey's allowed_degraded_modes for that data_source; else degraded_dishonest.
rationale: allowed_degraded_modes must have behavioral effect; degraded_mode (2a-core EvidenceRef field) carries the selected mode.

decision: typed-skip vs honest-degradation is discriminated at the journey EVIDENCE-SET level: a journey is satisfied only when its set ALSO contains a real (non-seeded) execution EvidenceRef; a set of only unavailable/typed-skip refs is unsatisfied. A typed-skip NEVER counts as a satisfying consumer-surface capture (shared with 2a-core F002).

cross_surface_disagreement is computed at the OBJECTIVE level: EvidenceRefs are grouped by a pinned objective key, then keyed by data_source within it; the human-vs-agent comparison boundary is the (objective, data_source) pair, not loose journey scanning.
rationale: Round-3 (2a) high: the objective-level collection/comparison boundary was unpinned — the keying is conceptual, the reason this plan was split out.

decision: Minimal human-family compatibility: existing human EvidenceRefs populate the shared structured fields (data_source/availability/consumer_family/degraded_mode); NOT a rebuild of human-surface capture (non-goal). A test asserts a human unavailable-label ref with those fields is consumed.
rationale: Carried 2a fix; non-goal excludes rebuilding human capture.

decision: As-merged 2a-core alignment (2a-core MERGED to main PR #55 1b90198): this follow-up CONSUMES the merged EvidenceRef vocabulary — data_source, availability, data_provenance, consumer_family, degraded_mode, surface_class. 2a-core kept consumer_family explicit with the D065 family-consistency invariant (consumer_family == SurfaceFamily(surface_class)), so the per-family degraded-honesty checker reads consumer_family safely. Interaction with 2a-core D060 (agent-now/human-later scope): per-family honesty for the HUMAN family applies only to TYPED human EvidenceRefs carrying the structured fields (the D007 minimal human-compat path); an UNTYPED human family for a data_source is not_yet_typed (2a-core D060), NOT degraded_dishonest. cross_surface_disagreement keyed by (objective, data_source) (D006) reads the merged structured fields. Close-enforcement remains OUT (plan 2b). Also: remapped 5 stale decision citations carried over from the pre-split combined-2a numbering (D012->D002, D036->D003, D038->D004, D023->D005, D047->D007).
